akien_ratified_intent_verbatim: we intend that we can extract debug and grow these specific nexi, knowing we'll find more nexi and more details for each as we go. and the ui shall be /chart <something> --- learning from /moreabout <something>. why: improve the work claude is doing by giving him a more deterministic input.
akien_deltas_beyond_the_web_doc: (1) THE MINI AGENTIC LOOP IS FIRST-CLASS ANATOMY: a question nexus is NOT post-input-to-graph-trees-get-output. Inside every nexus runs a mini agentic loop (think -> act -> observe, until the LOCAL exit condition) that ACTIVELY ASSEMBLES its output using the tools (trees + core questions + domain knowledge). 'this has been implicit in the work done so far, but it can't be. implicit things will get missed.' The loop evolves as we go. Established nexus anatomy restated: input + feedback + candidate core questions + domain-specific knowledge + core questions + output — the loop is what WORKS those parts.

(2) ORIENTATION FIRST because we MEASURED the failure: getting the web server carrier wrong (the /harbor-exception parallel, CC-- 2026-07-28) is the premature-convergence failure observed at home, not just in the web doc's telling.

(3) THE SKILL-DOOR FACTS about CC (Akien's observations, load-bearing for the design): CC skips steps when the answer looks visible; a plain instruction gets executed directly rather than routed through a skill; but /skillname fires reliably. Therefore orientation-first cannot live as discipline — it lives behind the slash-door.

(4) THE WORK PATTERN (built at Akien's work from these ideas): the 8-pass preamble (orient/constrain/survey/decompose/triage/hypothesize/validate/build) is stable across tasks; most passes are deterministic (retrieval, rule-application, cache-lookup) wearing the costume of reasoning; pre-answer them in ordinary code and hand the model a BUILD PACKET (intent/constraints/context/sub-problems/known-vs-novel/success-criteria); measured ~89% token cut on builds before caching. Hypothesize + Build are what currently earn a model.

(5) THE TENSION Akien posed: all-deterministic-now vs learning-pieces (Claude-skill per stage emitting JSON, later compiled to learning with Hex failover). His leans, stated before CC answered: individual units over a single monolithic packet-builder; and a chaining skill.

(6) THE WHY, SHARPENED (Akien, same day, after the first capture): 'to make your work better by giving you more deterministic input. why: so we can inspect and improve what you're getting.' INSPECTABILITY is the load-bearing half — CC's orientation today is invisible reasoning; as a typed packet on disk it can be inspected, diffed, improved.

(7) THE LIBRARIAN UNIFICATION (Akien): 'we'll use the same tools with the librarian. it's agenic loop will just be a simpler form of yours.' The nexi are SHARED machinery, not CC-tooling the librarian imitates — one loop shape, two complexity settings; every Cairn agent draws on the same nexuses (the web doc's section 3, now ratified as the librarian's own path).
resolution_three_strata: The two options are not at odds — one is the FLOOR of the other. Each nexus is built as three strata, tried in order: (1) DETERMINISTIC FLOOR — ordinary code: parse, index, convention lookup, cache; (2) TREE WALK — the nexus's graph tree, everything past crossings compiled; (3) CLAUDE CEILING — the mini agentic loop assembling what the layers below couldn't, depositing back (Law 1) so the stratum boundary moves down over time. This is loop.py's shape (graph-first, miss->LLM) with a code floor under it. The 89% becomes a PER-NEXUS MEASURED DIAL: fraction of output fields filled by floor vs tree vs claude, over time — the honest form of the compilation claim (Law 3).
individual_units_one_packet: Individual nexi, ONE packet. The monolith can't be scored/shadowed/promoted PIECEMEAL — and piecemeal is the entire shadow-champion play (Hex shadows one nexus; /moreabout frequency indicts one nexus; a model upgrade reopens one nexus's proof). But the BUILD PACKET survives as the EMITTED ARTIFACT — the concatenation of the typed outputs, what the build stage receives.
chart_skill_as_physics: /chart chains the nexi via SCHEMA-GATED HANDOFFS: each nexus emits typed JSON to a file; the skill validates shape (the append-door pattern, Law 4); the NEXT stage's prompt is TEMPLATE-FILLED from the PREVIOUS stage's file — so a skipped stage is not a lapse, it is a build error (decompose's prompt cannot be constructed without survey's output). The doc's parsimony test ('could the next prompt be template-filled with zero re-reading?') stops being review and becomes the mechanism. This is the ratified pattern from the daemons correction: CC-discipline into skill-STEPS, not habit.
moreabout_skill_as_learning_door: /moreabout <something> makes recoverable compression INVOCABLE: when a packet field is too compressed, CC invokes it instead of silently re-reading around it — and the invocation ITSELF is the labeled training signal ('this field, at this compression, wasn't enough for this class'), writing back into the upstream nexus's tree. Silent workaround becomes visible lesson. Calls must be SCOPED. Implementation lean (open in the web doc, leaning ratified here): a cheap lookup against the upstream nexus's already-deposited internal state — a graph walk, zero new inference — never a fresh re-run.
cautions_from_our_own_measurements: (a) THE FLOOR CAN POISON DOWNSTREAM: a wrong deterministic answer arrives wearing certainty. Provenance travels PER-FIELD in the packet (floor|tree|claude + confidence); validate may distrust by stratum. Home-field advantage in new clothes; tenure loop covers the tree stratum; the floor needs its own staleness story — EVENT-driven invalidation (file-change), never a clock.

(b) THE FLOOR IS WHERE PREMATURE CONVERGENCE SNEAKS BACK: retrieval answers WHAT EXISTS; only the loop above may decide WHAT APPLIES. Keep that seam explicit in each nexus's charter — the /harbor-exception drift is exactly a floor-match applied without the applies-judgment.

(c) SHADOW SCORING must stay DOWNSTREAM of the nexus (behavioral match: would downstream have made the same call) — a nexus scored by its own tree's confidence can manufacture its own promotion (measured: content-wrong mints satisfied the floor at 0.8295). Promotion-after-N-matches is Law 8 for model-swaps.
(d) 'occasionally re-shadow the champion' must be event-driven (model-swap event, every-Nth-crossing), never a clock — NO DAEMONS applies to scoring cadence.
naming: /chart — ratified. Native-domain derivable (you chart a course before you sail; charting IS orient/constrain/survey/decompose), sits beside charter/voyage/harbor. 'sprint'/'build' rejected (ceremony vocabulary, not ship vocabulary). 'question nexus' (plural 'nexi') bound as the term for the standalone typed unit; 'BUILD PACKET' for the emitted artifact.
tensions_held_from_the_earlier_exchange: (1) ORIENTATION-BLIND vs STAND-IN-ITS-DIRECTORY: co-location serves the settled; blind orientation serves the novel. Reconciliation is SEQUENCING — orient decides what is being asked with the folder curtained, THEN the brief fires as answer-space. The curtain must eventually be physics (what orient may READ is a gate); until then it is an IOU.

(2) ESCALATION DISPATCHER (chat loop vs research loop) vs ROUTE-IS-PHYSICS: start as physics (an explicit research: verb/prefix); the escalation nexus accumulates evidence toward a learned dispatcher it EARNS.
relation_to_existing_threads: The librarian chain (5 stones, PROVED) is nexus #0 — the proof-of-concept for every nexus's tree+loop shape. The cocoon thread (settle stages around CC, distant) — this IS its first concrete, gated form; shadow/champion is the withdrawal dial with measurement. The tenure loop (librarian edge l, sharpest filed pull) is the tree-stratum defense here and gains a third why (/moreabout frequency as tenure signal). Akien had planned to go back into the librarian; the web-server miss redirected to orientation-first.
sequencing: Orient is nexus #1 — built as a full three-strata unit with its typed exit schema, proven against the real operational agent (CC on real tasks; score: did downstream proceed without re-orienting). Then constrain, then down the stack (survey, decompose, triage, hypothesize, validate). /chart chains each as it lands, growing a stage at a time. Hex shadow/champion comes after nexi exist to shadow.
